claims.statement: For an exact rank-three signature-(2,1) quadratic form, after spectral scaling the minority-side density is exactly the hyperbolic-ray trace H_rho obtained by a full-dimensional change of variables; the full scaled L-infinity height is between M_- and max(pi*sqrt(2),M_-), where the pi*sqrt(2) majority-side bound is the completed fleet02/B15 ruled theorem. Thus finiteness of the exact-rank-three indefinite universal constant is equivalent to a universal product-provenance hyperbolic-ray trace bound.

For each fixed exact rank-three signature-(2,1) affine-in-range instance with critical value c and s=s3(A), the continuous C0 density satisfies p(t)<=pi*sqrt(2)/s for every t>=c, including p(c); any attained maximum above that threshold lies strictly on the minority/two-sheet side.

partner_dependencies.use: majority-sign one-sheet bound applied to the actual full-density and tent inequalities
fixed-matrix rank>=3 C0 regularity used only for pointwise critical-value/maximizer localization
